## Description

Trains deep reinforcement learning portfolio agents within a Wasserstein ambiguity set of state transition distributions, guaranteeing robust out-of-sample performance during macro regime shifts.

## Where it may fit

Multi-asset tactical allocation, extreme macroeconomic structural shifts, volatile asset return regimes.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Multi-Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Historical multivariate asset return panels, macroeconomic leading indicators, risk tolerance parameters.

## Caveats

Robust Markov Decision Process (MDP) training increases computational training overhead significantly.
